## Invitations

A total of 1935 people were invited to attend the outreach activity. Of these, 1432 attended, giving an attendance rate of 74.0 per cent. The result indicates that most invited people took part. Attendance was recorded against the invitations issued, providing a clear basis for monitoring participation.

Arrangements were made to support access where possible. Van days were maintained where road conditions allowed, helping to provide a practical outreach option in areas affected by local access constraints. These arrangements were subject to road access and operational feasibility.

## Contact

SMS contact was used to support the invitation process. A total of 1618 invitations were sent by SMS, and 1618 people received a reminder message. The reminder provided an additional prompt for attendance and supported communication with those invited.

The contact activity complemented the in-person outreach arrangements and helped maintain communication with invited people. Records of invitations, attendance, SMS contact and reminders have been retained for reporting purposes.

Prepared by G. Evans.
